text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, look at this!
A package arrived today, but...

What Oguri Cap handed over was a red scarf,
just like the one from her racing outfit.

On the inside of the parts hidden by clothing,
there were supportive messages for Oguri Cap written together as a collective sign-off.

Deeply reminded of how much she is loved by everyone,
I hand the scarf back to Oguri Cap.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. Messages from everyone
are written on it.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"‘We're always cheering you on nearby.’ ‘We'll run together.’
‘Because you're our dream, Oguri.’"

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: A dream... What could this mean?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I know people are delighted when I run, but... what does it mean for me to be their dream?
choice_data_list: So many feelings and hopes have been entrusted to it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Countless feelings?

I told Oguri Cap that I believe she is someone
who gives shape to people's yearnings, hopes, and diverse feelings.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I can't explain it very well, but...
Does this mean everyone is cheering for me and entrusting their wishes to me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
"...What is this? My chest feels so warm.
I feel like... I'm not alone."

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. It's certainly not light,
but I believe this weight will push me forward.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Rather than pressure,
I find it incredibly reassuring...

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm dying to run.
Trainer, care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you...!

I decided to keep Oguri Cap company to her heart's content
until she was completely satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Haaah, haaah... Phew.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...At first, I wondered
a little about what meaning this outfit held.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I understand now. Knowing it was for my
'racing outfit,' they all gifted me that scarf.”

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
A wish for my victory... This outfit right now
is truly filled with everyone's hopes.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Besides... my feelings are with you now as well.
A strong desire to win.
choice_data_list: My feelings are with you too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Besides... my feelings are with you now as well.
A strong desire to win.
choice_data_list: My feelings are with you too!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My Trainer's feelings are held
closest to my heart.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'll run carrying all of our hopes and feelings.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Let's keep on winning, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
Together with everyone's hopes...!
Seeing how highly motivated Oguri Cap was, I renewed my own determination for the race.
